mapper.sql: id, user_id, status, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM commercial_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO commercial_account (id, user_id, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, 'ACTIVE', 0, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = commercial_account.id
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM commercial_account WHERE id = #{accountId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity_micros), 0) FROM entitlement_grant WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(credit_micros), 0) FROM commercial_ledger_entry WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND entry_type = 'USAGE_DEBIT'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(remaining_micros), 0) FROM entitlement_grant WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND remaining_micros > 0 AND valid_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))
SELECT MIN(expires_at) FROM entitlement_grant WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND remaining_micros > 0 AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
SELECT aggregate_id FROM billing_outbox WHERE event_type = 'FULFILL_ORDER' AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id FROM entitlement_grant WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND remaining_micros > 0 AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM entitlement_grant WHERE id = #{grantId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE entitlement_grant SET status = 'EXPIRED', remaining_micros = 0, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{grantId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM billing_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE billing_order SET status = 'FULFILLING', updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{orderId}
UPDATE billing_outbox SET status = 'PROCESSED', processed_at = #{processedAt}, last_error = NULL WHERE aggregate_type = 'ORDER' AND aggregate_id = #{aggregateId} AND event_type = #{eventType}

UPDATE billing_outbox SET status = CASE WHEN retry_count >= 9 THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'RETRY' END, retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_attempt_at = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL LEAST(3600, POW(2, retry_count + 1)) SECOND), last_error = #{lastError} WHERE aggregate_type = 'ORDER' AND aggregate_id = #{orderNo} AND event_type = 'FULFILL_ORDER' AND status <> 'PROCESSED'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(reserved_credit_micros - consumed_credit_micros), 0) FROM commercial_reservation WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO commercial_reservation ( id, account_id, user_id, turn_id, reserved_credit_micros, consumed_credit_micros, status, expires_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES (#{id}, #{accountId}, #{userId}, #{turnId}, #{reservedCreditMicros}, 0, 'ACTIVE', #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE commercial_reservation SET status = 'RELEASED', updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO billable_usage ( id, usage_event_id, user_id, account_id, pricing_version_code, charge_credit_micros, usage_source, status, reservation_id, metadata_json, created_at ) VALUES (#{id}, #{usageEventId}, #{userId}, #{accountId}, #{pricingVersionCode}, #{chargeCreditMicros}, #{usageSource}, #{status}, #{reservationId}, #{metadataJson}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE billable_usage SET settled_at = #{settledAt} WHERE usage_event_id = #{usageEventId}
UPDATE billable_usage SET status = 'INSUFFICIENT', settled_at = #{settledAt} WHERE usage_event_id = #{usageEventId}
UPDATE billable_usage SET status = 'SETTLED', ledger_entry_id = #{ledgerEntryId}, settled_at = #{settledAt} WHERE usage_event_id = #{usageEventId}
mapper.select: SELECT e.event_id FROM ai_usage_event e LEFT JOIN billable_usage b ON b.usage_event_id = e.event_id WHERE b.usage_event_id IS NULL AND e.status = 'SUCCEEDED' ORDER BY e.received_at LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM ai_usage_event WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
SELECT * FROM billing_usage_pricing_version WHERE version_code = #{versionCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO billing_usage_pricing_version ( id, version_code, rules_json, status, effective_from, effective_until, created_at, published_at ) VALUES (#{id}, #{versionCode}, #{rulesJson}, 'PUBLISHED', #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveUntil}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM billing_usage_pricing_version WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO entitlement_grant ( id, account_id, grant_type, source_type, source_id, entitlement_code, price_version_code, quantity_micros, remaining_micros, valid_from, expires_at, status, metadata_json, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES (#{id}, #{accountId}, #{grantType}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{entitlementCode}, #{priceVersionCode}, #{quantityMicros}, #{quantityMicros}, #{validFrom}, #{expiresAt}, 'ACTIVE', #{metadataJson}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt})

INSERT IGNORE INTO commercial_ledger_entry ( id, account_id, grant_id, entry_type, direction, credit_micros, balance_after_micros, source_type, source_id, idempotency_key, occurred_at, expires_at, metadata_json, created_at ) VALUES (#{id}, #{accountId}, #{grantId}, #{entryType}, 'CREDIT', #{creditMicros}, #{balanceAfterMicros}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{occurredAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{metadataJson}, #{occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, remaining_micros, expires_at FROM entitlement_grant WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND remaining_micros > 0 AND valid_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY CASE WHEN expires_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, expires_at, created_at, id FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO commercial_ledger_entry ( id, account_id, grant_id, entry_type, direction, credit_micros, balance_after_micros, source_type, source_id, idempotency_key, occurred_at, expires_at, metadata_json, created_at ) VALUES (#{id}, #{accountId}, #{grantId}, 'USAGE_DEBIT', 'DEBIT', #{creditMicros}, #{balanceAfterMicros}, 'USAGE_EVENT', #{usageEventId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{occurredAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{metadataJson}, #{occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT o.order_no, o.product_snapshot, o.fulfilled_at, MAX(g.valid_from) AS valid_from, MAX(g.expires_at) AS expires_at FROM billing_order o INNER JOIN entitlement_grant g ON g.source_type = 'ORDER' AND g.source_id = o.order_no WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.status IN ('FULFILLED', 'REFUNDING') AND g.status = 'ACTIVE' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.product_snapshot, '$.productType')) = 'PLAN' AND (g.expires_at IS NULL OR g.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) GROUP BY o.id, o.order_no, o.product_snapshot, o.fulfilled_at ORDER BY expires_at DESC, o.fulfilled_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(g.expires_at) FROM entitlement_grant g INNER JOIN billing_order o ON o.order_no = g.source_id AND g.source_type = 'ORDER' WHERE g.account_id = #{accountId} AND g.status = 'ACTIVE' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.product_snapshot, '$.productType')) = 'PLAN'

SELECT version_code, rules_json FROM billing_usage_pricing_version WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (effective_until IS NULL OR effective_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY effective_from DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM commercial_reservation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND turn_id = #{turnId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
